data.title: Rent increase request (Mieterhöhungsverlangen) from Exempelkiez Wohnbau
data.summary: Exempelkiez Wohnbau GmbH asks tenant Aylin Exempeloğlu to agree to a rent increase (Mieterhöhungsverlangen nach § 558 BGB) for the Sonnenallee 210 apartment, raising the net cold rent from €642.00 to €718.00 per month, effective 1 February 2027, based on the Berlin rent index (Mietspiegel 2026).
data.explanation: Your landlord formally asks you to consent to a higher rent, citing the local rent comparison (Mietspiegel) for your area. You can accept, partly accept, or decline the proposed increase from €642.00 to €718.00 per month. The app shows the deadline by which you must reply, counted from when the letter was delivered to your mailbox. If you agree, sign and return the enclosed consent form. If you're unsure whether the requested amount is justified, you may want to check it against the current Mietspiegel or contact a tenants' association (Mieterverein) before responding.
